desc:
BLOCKING VISUAL ACCEPTANCE — Jason, 2026-10-15. Greg changes colour, design and proportions between animations; moving causes apparent stripes and pixelation. Beta must use the best consistent set possible.

DECISION: one canonical photo-based character master, measured template, locked palette/markings/stroke, stable world scale and manifest for ALL animations. One source of truth is mandatory. Runtime may use one atlas or multiple bounded atlas pages exported from the SAME template; making one huge PNG alone does not fix inconsistent drawings.

READ: assets/heel/anatomy-v2-photo-based/UNIFIED-ART-SPEC.md, template.json, REFERENCES.md; handoffs/codex-to-claude-greg-visual-reset-2026-10-15.md (saved).

PHOTO EVIDENCE: Google Photos Greg search surveyed to oldest result; 1,567 distinct search-result links encountered, including duplicates/videos/artwork/unrelated matches (not an exhaustive verified photo count). 21 selected Google Photos references plus 11 local Greg images saved/indexed privately. All angles required: front, both profiles, front/rear three-quarter, rear, standing, sitting, lying, curled and movement. Longer adult torso/back, believable shoulders/elbows/stifles/hocks, less exaggerated jowls; grey/charcoal coat, dark nose/muzzle, actual irregular chest marking. Subtle natural fur-covered male sheath where visible. Existing short side-view art rejected.

TEMPLATE: provisional 192x208 logical frame, baseline y196, root (96,196), safe rect x12..180/y12..196; 2x source proposed. Final accepted landmarks and palette must be frozen on the reviewed master. Constant physical size across poses; no automatic per-frame bounding-box normalization. Transparent lossless PNG; no texture/coat stripes or green fringe. Page count may change, geometry/scale must not.

SOURCE CHECK EXECUTED: current code already manifest-driven (A3a Done). Current Dot/smooth PNG dimensions match manifests; zero non-transparent pixels on cell borders in both. This does not reproduce or fix native stripes/pixelation. CLAUDE: reproduce exact current defect in real window; inspect source frame vs displayed frame, density, wrong rect/row selection, fractional sampling, scaling/adjacent cells, image-rendering and compression. Do not assume art-only or renderer-only root cause. Codex has not changed app code.

DONE: corrected multi-angle master and walk proof visually checked; all clips regenerated/normalized from it; all actions/transition/loop seams observed at 128px and actual native/Retina size on light/dark; no colour/size pulses, anatomy drift, stripes, pixelation, clipping or prop jitter; reduced-motion and Off verified; screenshots/video plus exact asset hash/manifest recorded. Frame counts and passing structural tests alone are insufficient.

Future AI video tooling is optional, not connected/purchased; any output still uses the same master and temporal/alpha/scale QA. Preserve old packs and compatible fallback until replacement acceptance.

SESSION OUTPUT — 2026-10-15:
Saved handoff: handoffs/codex-to-claude-greg-visual-reset-2026-10-15.md.
New candidate: assets/heel/anatomy-v2-photo-based/final/multi-angle-study-v2-flat.png (nine static views, RGBA 1254x1254; SHA256 6ae159026106304e22e783fc02c6022b4bfa854c426629c6d60a586fe7fab9d6).
This is an UNAPPROVED MODEL STUDY, not a calibrated atlas or rebuilt animation set. Initial study was too patchy; v2 is flatter but still needs exact palette/landmark/world-scale review and transparent clearance/edge cleanup (33 non-transparent outer-border pixels). Do not auto-fit poses into cells or treat the study's layout as runtime frame rectangles. Existing art remains preserved. Full rebuild, corrected walk proof and native defect reproduction/fix are pending.
Trello read-back verification: 17 related existing card descriptions updated and 3 new cards created. Completed platform statuses retained. Audit: assets/heel/anatomy-v2-photo-based/trello-update-audit.json.
